verified_checks.checked: Independent-set/clique/complement dictionary; maximal versus maximum; R(1,t)=1 and R(2,t)=t; simultaneous existence and recurrence induction; Pascal bound; greedy closed-neighbourhood deletion; alpha>=Delta for triangle-free graphs. In the overview, cited deep results are linked rather than presented as locally proved.

Exact first moments, strict expectation-below-one criterion, factorial-ratio limit, p=0 and p=1, and the direction of 1-p<=exp(-p). In alteration, a=ceil(4 n^(2/3) log n) is <=n for large n; the two bad-event probabilities sum to less than one; deleting original triangles cannot create new ones or increase alpha. The stated n(k) gives 4 n^(2/3) log n<=3k/8, and the floor costs only an absolute constant.

Computed the integral, including f(0)=1 and f(1)=1/2. Differentiation under the integral is legitimate locally for x>0; f'<0 and f''>0. The tangent inequality at x=0 follows by continuity, not by assuming a finite derivative at zero. Substitution verifies (d+1)f(d)=1+(d-d^2)f'(d); d=1 is treated separately. The asymptotic ratio is one.

Each removed edge has exactly one endpoint in N(v) in a triangle-free graph. Double counting yields E[e(G_v)]=e-sum(deg^2)/n. Multiplying the tangent inequality by n_v avoids division by zero when G_v is empty. The variance term is bounded above by d-d^2, and f'<0 reverses its contribution in the needed direction. The differential identity closes induction. Monotonicity f(d)>=f(k-1) gives the finite ceiling bound without assuming d tends to infinity.

Uniform sampling is over all independent sets including the empty set. Conditioning is restricted to positive-probability outside configurations. The centre plus all subsets of unblocked neighbours yield exactly 2^m+1 extensions; at m=0 both probabilities and the zero numerator are valid. For real d>=16 the two-case lower bound and sum_v X_v<=2d|S| give n log_2(d)/(12d). The complete-graph obstruction correctly rejects a hypothesis-free reading of SIAM Theorem 2.6.

An independent set projects to an independent support, giving alpha(H^(s))=s alpha(H) and P_blowup(z)=P_H((1+z)^s-1). Multicolour finite existence uses N=2+sum(a_i-1), not an incorrect two-colour recurrence. Independent uniform permutations give the exact union expectation i_k^2/binom(n,k). Overlapping edges are assigned to only one colour; each coloured graph remains triangle-free although the union need not be.

The cited HHKP lower constant is 1/2. For any fixed 0<c<1/2, n=floor(c k^2/log k) gives log n/log k->2 and sqrt(n log n)/k->sqrt(2c)<1, absorbing the o(1). The construction is described as the survey's outline, consistently with footnote 4. The independent-set stability estimate is an external input, not locally proved.

The combined expectation X-Y supplies a single simultaneous witness. Choosing one vertex from each original independent k-set and deleting their union destroys every such set. Negative right-hand sides, p=0, p=1, and k>n cause no failure; empty graphs are permitted here without using a maximum degree.

The remainder container is disjoint from T and has size at most R, so the second factor is binom(R,k-s). In 4V0M all three counting parameters are integers with 1<=s<=k<=n and 1<=R<=n. Fixed global tie-breaking makes choices deterministic. Selected vertices themselves are deleted along with neighbours. Every unchosen vertex of I survives, so s selections are possible. While |A|>=R, maximum degree is at least 2 beta |A|; beta<1/2 follows from the full-graph hypothesis. At or below the threshold the set cannot grow. Final T alone replays every decision before the s-th selection, proving deterministic reconstruction and the counting injection.

Edge-disjointness makes each retained edge belong to its unique block. A K4 meeting a block in three vertices would leave a forbidden triangle in that block. SIAM Theorem 4.1 gives c k^3/(log k)^4; its introduction also records the distinct upper bound C k^3/(log k)^2. The local page states only the lower bound and does not conflate authorship. The survey's illustrative p=q^-1, k=q(log q)^3 gives the ninth log power, explicitly distinguished from the fourth power in the cited theorem. Hermitian-unital existence and supersaturation remain external.

Uses the single-subset jumbled convention with p binom(u,2). Cancellation for a nonempty independent set gives alpha<=1+2 beta/p. The exact threshold for e(U)>=p u^2/4 is u>=2+4 beta/p, including the additive 2. Applying the container theorem uses p/4, not p. For R<n the ceiling of (4/p)log(n/R) is positive and ensures the exponential condition; s<=k remains explicitly required. This is a direct container corollary, not a claimed proof of the sharper Alon-Rodl Lemma 4.9.

A and Y are disjoint; no restriction is imposed inside Y. The red K_(k-t) or blue K_k dichotomy extends the book correctly for 1<=t<k. Theorem 9.1 has fixed r, delta(r)>0 and a threshold depending on r. Eight-author attribution is separate from the original four-author two-colour breakthrough. A uniform absolute positive delta is not inferred; the survey lists it as Conjecture 9.4. Lemma 9.2's abbreviated quantifiers are not imported as a precise local theorem.

The embedding preserves host nonedges, not merely differently coloured edges. The two directions of R_ind,r(K_k)=R_r(k) are valid, including restriction of an avoiding complete-graph colouring to any smaller host. Theorem 10.2 has an absolute C for every r>=2 and every k-vertex H. Theorem 10.3 uses n>=r^(Crk), delta=r^(-Crk) and success probability at least 1-exp(-delta n^2). All colourings are quantified after the random host is chosen. No false independence of an adversarial colouring is introduced.

Coordinate tuples are ordered, so expansion includes the required multinomial multiplicities automatically. For every multi-index of nonnegative integers, independence and identical laws give a sum of squared real expectations. Zero exponents use the empty product; the Z_i themselves need not be independent. The entire series for psi is valid also on negative inputs; finite support and absolute convergence justify termwise expectation. Marginal moment positivity alone would not suffice for g. This proves the written algebraic lemma, not the full geometric dichotomy or book iteration.

source_caveats_checked.resolution: The surrounding text requires triangle-free graphs although the theorem sentence omits that hypothesis. Local 4V0B-4V0C include it. Tests include K3's wrong extension count and K_8193 violating even the weaker constant-factor bound without the hypothesis.
Local 4V0V repairs the malformed inner-product notation and explicitly proves all mixed moments, not merely marginal ones.
The local definition deliberately bounds the remainder container C(T), not necessarily the full set T union C(T). The replay proof explicitly removes the chosen vertex.
The difference between the illustrative log^9 bound and the cited log^4 theorem is preserved rather than erased.
